profile.headline: iOS Team Lead, Senior Software Engineer at Vibrent Health
profile.jobTitle: iOS Team Lead, Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior software developer with extensive experience in iOS development, software engineering, mobile, and UI/UX design. Have taken multiple apps from inception to App Store release, with deep knowledge of mobile app development, design and maintenance. Proven track record in both small development teams and large distributed groups as both team member and lead. Twenty years experience in the full spectrum of development positions ranging from cross-platform programming to release management.

positions.title: iOS Team Lead, Senior Software Engineer
Lead Developer, Technical Co-Founder
positions.description:
Created and founded Yonward, the leading platform to create, share, and experience augmented reality guides for any location. Implemented the iOS product from prototype to release, built Yonward dev team, UI/UX team and additional management, achieved initial funding, and released 14 versions to the AppStore. Yonward was accepted to the Mass Challenge, Summer 2016 and can be currently found in the AppStore with a 5 star rating.

Responsible for the iOS app development, core R&D, architecture, defect resolution, AppStore submission/review/release, and patent applications. Implemented news feeds, location-based search, location-based media playback, notification systems, social layer (friend/follow/like), Google/Apple Maps integration, profiles, user authentication, custom interface components, caching, image manipulation and filters, and social media integration (Facebook, Twitter, etc.).

- Led the development and launch of a groundbreaking consumer product and platform focused on augmented reality for the travel industry
- Simultaneously led software developers, UI/UX designers, marketing and business development to bring our vision to life
- Led beta-testing programs and worked with users to collect feedback and model usage
- Responsible for extensive competitive and market analysis across multiple verticals
- Created the content creation networks of bloggers, journalists and interns
- Developed marketing strategies to increase adoption and solidify channel partnerships 
- Responsible for primary and backup pitch decks for investors, technical and business due-diligence
- Built the channel partner network

positions.title: Violinist
positions.description:
Well-known performer with appearances at:
 
- The Kennedy Center
- Carnegie Hall
- Glasgow Royal Concert Hall
- Featured in PBS documentary “Absolutely Irish”. 
- Five albums to date. Member of acclaimed touring groups, including Green Fields of America.

positions.title: Director, Enterprise Content Management
positions.description:
Responsible for development of custom IS risk management and compliance systems for the highly regulated financial sector. Led Affusion’s engagement with Citigroup to create, deploy, and maintain custom risk management, IS, and compliance systems. Responsible for ECM integration, portal creation, risk assessment systems and executive dashboards for senior management

- Created the IS Risk Management Portal by coordinating multiple development teams in three countries
- Deployed to tens of thousands of users under budget and ahead of schedule
- Managed multiple distributed development and testing teams throughout the product life-cycle
- Responsible for functional and technical specifications, coordinating with multiple major business units across Citigroup
- Developed training programs

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Led development of a multi-phase rollout of a custom ECM system for Pfizer’s regulatory compliance and document life-cycle management to over 50,000 seats.

- Implemented custom Workflow, Category, Attribute, and Records Management modules in OpenText’s Livelink
- Created automated workflows to assist in the document lifecycle management for compliance with federal regulatory guidelines
- Created a best-practices custom ECM environment deployed to 30,000 users

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of 15-person development team for OpenText’s Livelink, the global leader in enterprise content management, workflow, and business process management. Ownership of features spanning the entire product suite, on all major platforms and databases. Responsibilities included feature development, coordination with design teams, defect triage and resolution, developer mentoring, server development, and QA testing.

- Wrote numerous major Livelink modules in OScript and C++ used by hundreds of thousands of users
- Led the company-wide, multi-national Unicode compliance effort
- Led the Wells Fargo security review of the entire 1.5 million line code-base of Livelink
